messages:
anya: FYI edu-acme reporting SAML logins started failing right after the RBAC rename last night (we replaced sso_user -> app_user). SCIM jobs appear green but login exchange returns 401 for a subset of users. anyone seen this exact symptom?

sam: pulling idp traces now. snippet: 
``n[2026-03-22T03:11:52Z] ERROR=AuthExchange assertion_invalid 401
subject=user@acme.edu
attrs={email:"user@acme.edu", displayName:"U A"}
missing_attrs=["roles"]
```
Looks like roles attribute not present in the assertion payload for the failing cases.

kyle: did we do any KMS key rewraps or swap the idp service account IAM during the rollout? If assertion encryption/decryption fails you'd see kms decrypt errors.

maria: signing key rotation was deployed but encryption key alias didn't change per the audit. I am seeing a decrypt DENIED for trace=trace-xyz at 03:12:14 though.

devops-bot: kms-decrypt-errors alias=alias/redwood-idp-enc count=1 window=24h
- 2026-03-22T03:12:14 trace=trace-xyz status=ACCESS_DENIED principal=svc-idp

sam: ACCESS_DENIED suggests the svc-idp principal lacked kms:Decrypt at that instant OR the request used a different alias. kyle can you run the alias mapping + role policy checks: 
``naws kms list-aliases --alias-name-prefix alias/redwood-idp
aws iam get-role-policy --role-name svc-idp-role --policy-name idp-kms
```

kyle: checked live. svc-idp-role still includes kms:Decrypt, alias/redwood-idp-enc points to key-0a1b2c. No rewrap recorded for that key. The one ACCESS_DENIED looks like an STS token expiry hitting mid-request during maintenance.

anya: note also that most affected accounts were migrated via SCIM earlier this month. Could be an externalId normalization mismatch.

maria: pulling SCIM create for one affected user: 
``nPOST /scim/v2/Users 200
payload.externalId="user123 "
createdAt=2026-03-05T12:02:11Z
```
DB has external_id="user123" (no trailing space). We pushed a role-rename job yesterday that trims/normalizes role names; it also started trimming differently than the SCIM flow.

sam: that could break the lookup that maps identities -> roles. If the identity key differs (trailing space), role service won't attach roles and assertions will lack roles -> 401. Explains subset.

kyle: remediation plan: 1) make role-renamer whitespace-tolerant/idempotent; 2) backfill/normalize SCIM externalId values; 3) short-term reprovision affected users.

maria: starting reprovision for tenant edu-acme for the flagged users. Query used to detect mismatches: 
``nselect u.id from users u join scim_provision p on p.external_id != trim(u.external_id) where p.tenant='edu-acme'
```
We have ~34 users. Kicking off --force reprovision now.

devops-bot: job=scim-reprovision-edu-acme-34 queued by maria link=https://ci.internal/jobs/98765

sam: we should also improve audit for the role-rename job (include transform diff and affected ids). Current audit entries are too sparse. Add to postmortem.

maria: reprovision update: first run finished, 28/34 succeeded, 6 failed. I'm re-running a delete+create for the remaining six.

sam: for those 6 can you paste a redacted SAML assertion to see whether roles attr is missing vs present-but-empty?

maria: sample assertion: 
``n<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Subject>user@acme.edu</saml:Subject>
  <saml:Attribute Name="roles"></saml:Attribute>
</saml:Assertion>
```
roles present but empty. That indicates mapping logic ran but returned empty set.

anya: sounds like role lookup returned empty because it looked up using untrimmed externalid. For the remaining accounts I'll force-map via legacy id and push a patch to role-rename to be trim-safe.

devops-bot: incident created INC-20260322-42 by anya status=investigating link=https://incidents.internal/INC-20260322-42

kyle: side-investigation: IAM STS probe confirms the single ACCESS_DENIED was an ephemeral STS token expiry at 03:12:14 tied to a short window during our deploy. Not the root cause for missing roles but worth noting in the incident timeline.

sam: action items: write audit-rich backfill script (sam), run SCIM normalization (sam+maria), add defensive trimming in idp-proxy parser (kyle -> eng-runtime PR to staging), harden role-rename job to ignore whitespace and record diffs (anya), reprovision complete and confirm.

maria: final smoke after backfill: 34/34 edu-acme users can login. Adding affected user IDs to the incident notes.

anya: I'll own the postmortem + timeline. Please drop any other tenant-reports into this thread. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
